note: Public Base (8453) RPC endpoints, probed 2026-10-29 between 11:51 and 12:40 UTC with an adapted copy of scripts/probe-rpcs.mjs (chainId, head, eth_getLogs span on an empty filter and on DEGEN Transfer logs, eth_call state override with `code`, `stateDiff` and `state`, eth_getStorageAt on the v4 PoolManager, 20 concurrent eth_blockNumber), plus archive/trace checks. Same shape as data/rpc-endpoints.json: 'logs' = serves eth_getLogs over a ≥ 10,000-block range (lib/onchain/rpc.ts routes eth_getLogs only to these); logsMaxSpan = widest span that succeeded (callers must chunk by it); 'override' = eth_call state override (`code`) works. Extra fields: stateDiff/state = the override object accepts those keys; logsHistory = how far back logs are served; archiveState = eth_getCode/eth_getBalance at an old block; trace = debug_traceTransaction(callTracer). Nothing here was assumed: every field is a call result from this run.
